title: save_deployment_target input
description: Registers a place deployments land, changes one, retires one or returns a retired one to service (O15). Served only to a person in the product's web app: the stage decides the gate level a deployment there meets, and the change path decides which routes are flagged. A new target needs its kind, stage, change path, link kind, external ID and label; Link Kind and External Id are its business key. record_deployment takes only a registered target in service. Retiring takes a reason and nothing else; a retired target keeps its deployment records and refuses new ones with the reason.

deploymentTargetId.description: The target to change. Leave it out to register a new one.

targetKindKey.description: The kind, from the target-kind list: Power Platform environment, Microsoft 365 tenant, Azure resource group, GitHub environment, SaaS tenant or other.

targetStageKey.description: Development, test, production or a client stage.

externalId.description: The tool's ID, such as the Power Platform environment ID.

url.description: A link that opens the target.

retire.description: True retires the target today (with retiredReason); false returns a retired target to service. Nothing else changes in the same call.

retiredReason.description: Why the target is retired, such as the environment that replaced it. Required with retire true.

examples.retiredReason: Replaced by the new operations production environment.
